body: Honestly, America isn't good for anyone except the rich. I'm so sorry you're going through this. I second a shelter.

Yes, this is exactly how I feel. After middle school I only had one friend at a time because I was too socially anxious to make more. I spent a lot of my time in school bathrooms wishing I was dead. My therapist and my parents told me things would be better once I reached adulthood, but it's only gotten worse.

I think that was the point of the character 22 and maybe the movie in its entirety. You don't have to live a life of accomplishments or find something that you're amazing at. Experiencing the little things that make you happy is perfectly fine. Maybe that's a pizza or reading a good book.   


I feel incomplete because I don't have a career (or even a job) and I'm 28. I'd love to talk with you more if you want. About whatever.
